timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹179.63 Cr, net profit ₹14.98 Cr (+399.3% YoY).
Kanpur Plastipack reported Q4 FY26 consolidated total income of ₹185.05 Cr and net profit of ₹14.92 Cr, with full-year FY26 net profit rising 76.39% YoY to ₹40.80 Cr.
Kanpur Plastipack reported FY26 standalone total income of ₹726.67 Cr and net profit of ₹38.19 Cr, up 68% YoY.
Kanpur Plastipack Limited held an earnings conference call on May 04, 2026, at 11:30 AM for Q4FY26 results, with audio recording available on the company website.
Kanpur Plastipack granted 4,04,740 ESOP options at an exercise price of ₹202 per option under its 2025 scheme.
Ankur Srivastava (Promoter) disclosed yearly shareholding under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026 on 7 April 2026.
Kanpur Plastipack Limited will host an Earnings Conference Call on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 3:00 PM.
